title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct mean free path value of l = 10^6 cm.

title: Density Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the atmospheric density using n = p/(kT).

title: Mean Free Path Formula
description: Essential Criteria: The student must use the correct formula for mean free path l = 1/(pi n sigma).

title: Cross Section Value
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and use the value of sigma = 10^-26 cm^2.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect use of constants.
